Chapter 1252: Chapter 11: The Undisputed Invincible Great Saint (Seeking Base Monthly Tickets at the Beginning of the Month)_2

“The power of the Galaxy Great Saint is too strong, I suppose Luo Hou Great Saint won’t blame us,” the bald man said, “but we still ought to meet Luo Hou Great Saint to explain in person.”

“Indeed.”

The gaunt figure nodded.

They are merely serving Luo Hou Great Saint, not as slaves, and they possess the right to choose.

Even the Invincible Great Saint wouldn’t recklessly force a peerless Great Saint too much.

…

The towering palace stood at the deepest point of time and space.

On the throne at the highest point of the palace sat a figure shrouded in gray mist.

“Galaxy Great Saint?”

The gray misty figure was none other than Luo Hou Great Saint, who was muttering to himself, watching scenes outside the Galaxy Chaos Continent flashing before him.

The token he had bestowed was crushed, and a wisp of his avatar descended, naturally witnessing the scene of Lin Yuan making his move.

“This Galaxy Great Saint, just how many thirteen-stage inheritances has he mastered?” The gray misty figure found it hard to believe. Despite the brief glimpse, he faintly sensed that the thirteen-stage power involved during the obliteration of his avatar could include three or four types.

For instance, the omnipresent suppression of time and space, or the Fierce Sun incarnated by the Galaxy Great Saint, and such.

All contained power transcending the twelfth stage, likely some form of thirteen-stage inheritance.

“Three or four types of thirteen-stage inheritance, not only practiced but also perfectly integrated together? This Galaxy Great Saint truly…” Luo Hou Great Saint couldn’t comprehend.

After mastering one thirteen-stage inheritance, practicing a second would see the difficulty soar, as the thirteen-stage inheritance carries thirteen-stage power, and it is already a strain for a twelfth-stage being to bear thirteen-stage power, let alone more than one.

Wow!

At that moment.

The bald man and the gaunt figure appeared inside the palace.

“Great Saint.”

The bald man and the gaunt figure bowed slightly.

“No need to say much, I already know.”

Luo Hou Great Saint gazed down at the two peerless Great Saints, “That Galaxy Great Saint, you needn’t concern yourselves with him in the future.”

“Yes.”

The bald man and the gaunt figure responded. Even if Luo Hou Great Saint had instructed them to confront the Galaxy Great Saint, the two peerless Great Saints would have refused. A joke? Confront the Galaxy Great Saint? How is that different from seeking death?

“Luo Hou Great Saint, Galaxy Great Saint?”

The bald man tentatively asked; they knew the Galaxy Great Saint was strong, but the extent was unclear to them.

Yet, Luo Hou Great Saint’s power far exceeded theirs, so he likely saw much clearer than they did.

“Galaxy Great Saint… very strong, extremely strong, not my opponent at all.”

Luo Hou Great Saint remained silent for a while before stating truthfully.

Though it was just a fleeting glance of an avatar, and he hadn’t even witnessed the true strength of the Galaxy Great Saint, Luo Hou Great Saint was very aware that he was far from being a match for the Galaxy Great Saint.

Even though it was just an avatar, they shared the same mind and will, and at that time, Luo Hou Great Saint felt as if the entire Chaos Void was collapsing upon him.

Luo Hou Great Saint had a feeling that, even if it were his true self facing the Galaxy Great Saint, the final outcome would be no different, vanishing to ashes under the fierce sun that was the Galaxy Great Saint.

“…”

Luo Hou Great Saint’s frankness left the bald man and the gaunt figure in silence.

The two peerless Great Saints indeed sensed that Luo Hou Great Saint was no match for the Galaxy Great Saint. The sense of oppression they felt from both was entirely different.

Yet Luo Hou Great Saint’s candid admission left the bald man and the gaunt figure ever more astonished.

This meant that the disparity in strength was not just present but extraordinarily large, to the point where Luo Hou Great Saint didn’t even entertain the thought of fighting.

“Henceforth, you no longer need to follow me. Do as you wish.”

Luo Hou Great Saint looked at the two peerless Great Saints, sighed inwardly, and spoke up.

Originally, he planned to sweep across the Chaos Void to prove the title of the ‘Invincible Great Saint,’ which was why he subdued some peerless Great Saints, planning to use them in the future to govern vast tracts of void.

Each Invincible Great Saint would typically establish their own power, having numerous followers to serve.

But now?

Luo Hou Great Saint knew that his plan had become unattainable.

With the Galaxy Great Saint around, even if he possessed the strength of a conventional Invincible Great Saint, he would never become invincible, as he was simply no match for the Galaxy Great Saint.

“Yes.”

The bald man and the gaunt figure exchanged glances, and they did not refuse.

As peerless Great Saints, their willingness to follow Luo Hou Great Saint was based on their belief that he could become an Invincible Great Saint in the future.

Now that possibility was gone, the bald man and the gaunt figure naturally did not plan to continue following.

…

Luo Hou Great Saint watched as the bald man and the gaunt figure vanished.

Subsequently, he summoned the subdued peerless Great Saints to dismiss them all before completely sealing the palace.

“Chaos Void, throughout eternity, no matter how strong, can only dominate for a while; only by stepping into the thirteenth stage and becoming a life of time can one attain ultimate freedom.”

Luo Hou Great Saint, with a tranquil heart, intended to immediately rush for the thirteenth stage.

As it stands, he had achieved perfection in all areas, realm, strength, insights into the thirteen-stage inheritance’s power, and so on.

If it weren’t for wanting to leave behind his name in the Chaos Void by becoming an Invincible Great Saint, he would have begun his charge for the thirteenth stage long ago.

…

Within the twisted time-space.

Several special conscious entities gazed from afar at the Galaxy Chaos Continent.

“This Galaxy Great Saint is by no means one of the top ten, top five, or top three Invincible Great Saints in Chaos Void history.”

A shattered longsword emitted a wave of consciousness: “He is the strongest Invincible Great Saint. Not even those original beings born at the beginning of Chaos Void could match the current Galaxy Great Saint.”

The shattered longsword’s tone was filled with emotion. Observing up close, they discovered more of Lin Yuan’s depths; even though annihilating two peerless Great Saints was merely a casual move, the levels of power involved seemed inconceivable to the special entities.

“The strongest Invincible Great Saint…”

The other special conscious entities were full of admiration. The initial beings born at the inception of Chaos Void, replete with chaotic void’s creation, were incredibly profound in their foundations, yet they still fell short compared to the Galaxy Great Saint?

Even these special entities found it unbelievable.

“How exactly did this Galaxy Great Saint cultivate?”

The consciousness of the ancient Altar Spirit voiced, finding it simply against reason.

“Galaxy Great Saint…” The Eye of Myriad Laws was filled with delight.

It held high expectations for Lin Yuan but hadn’t expected him to grow to such a level? The strongest Invincible Great Saint in Chaos Void history?

…

As time flew by.

The battle outside the Galaxy Chaos Continent spread at an alarming rate.

One by one, Chaos Great Saints and even peerless Great Saints witnessed the image loops of that battle.

“Too strong.”

“Not an opponent.”

“I’m not an opponent either.”

“How to resist? In this battle, the Galaxy Great Saint probably didn’t even exert full strength.”

…

Many ancient peerless Great Saints, after seeing the battle imagery, did not even entertain thoughts of challenge and directly acknowledged their inferiority.

As peerless Great Saints, they had a firm grasp on power. If it were merely slightly stronger, they wouldn’t concede so readily, but the gap between the Galaxy Great Saint and them was far more than just simple.

“Galaxy Great Saint is the Invincible Great Saint of this era.”

“Indeed, indisputably the Invincible Great Saint.”

Some peerless Great Saints expressed thoughts. Though they didn’t gain universal recognition among peerless Great Saints, none opposed the notion.

Who dared to oppose?

And for peerless Great Saints, not opposing is as good as acknowledging.

…

Deep within the Galaxy Chaos Continent.

Lin Yuan also sensed the impact of his actions on the Chaos Void, even beginning to be widely acknowledged as the Invincible Great Saint of this era.

“Invincible Great Saint?”

Lin Yuan’s expression was peculiar. The Invincible Great Saints in Chaos Void history all earned their name through countless fierce battles, subduing those peerless Great Saints to eventually prove the title of the Invincible Great Saint.

And with just a single move, he was hailed as the Invincible Great Saint?

“But with my current strength, there shouldn’t be any spiritual entity in any special place daring to oppose me, right?”

Lin Yuan’s mind expanded, contemplating the vague future timeline fragments he glimpsed under the Sky Void Tripod’s augmentation.
